title: Vibrant Jamaican Patties
description: Peppery, dense, Jamaican patties featuring Asian-chive-buchu and char-grilled flavors, perfect for a vegetarian meal.
instructions: Combine Asian chive-buchu paste, char-grilled onion, cayenne pepper, cumin, and lime juice in a large bowl.
Add cassava flour, salt, and chopped cilantro to the bowl, and mix until well combined.
Gradually add the melted butter, mixing until a smooth dough forms.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces, and shape each into a ball.
Roll out each ball into a thin circle, about 1/8 inch thick.
Place the patties on a lightly oiled baking sheet, and chill in the refrigerator for at least 30 minutes.
Preheat a non-stick skillet or griddle to medium heat.
Cook the patties for 2-3 minutes on each side, until golden brown and crispy.
Serve the patties warm, garnished with additional cilantro and lime wedges.
